persona: Mid-level Finacle functional consultant from a bank branch background
resumeText:
Rahul Deshpande | Pune | rahul.deshpande@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Finacle Functional Consultant, Sahyadri Banking Solutions, Pune (2020 - present)
- Set up savings and current account schemes in Finacle 10.x for a regional rural bank rollout.
- Parameterised term deposit and retail loan products, including interest tables and GL mapping.
- Wrote functional requirement documents from workshops with bank operations teams.
- Prepared UAT test scenarios and ran UAT cycles with branch users before go-live.
- Used SQL queries to validate account balances and interest accruals.
- Coordinated sign-offs with the bank's IT and operations heads.

Assistant Manager - Branch Operations, Konkan Urban Co-operative Bank, Ratnagiri (2018 - 2020)
- Handled CASA account opening, cheque clearing and cash operations at the branch.

EDUCATION
BCom, University of Mumbai, 2018
